one_liner: SEO/AEO data platform with a public REST API and hosted MCP server.
access_notes: API key: owners/admins create in Account settings; OAuth: apply to Ahrefs Connect, get client credentials, approval before going live.
blocker_notes: Direct API access is on paid tiers with unit caps; Enterprise offers uncapped API access.

evidence.quote: Provide it in the Authorization header when making requests: “Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY”.
Ahrefs Connect uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE).
Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans.
API & Integrations… Direct API access… Max rows per request… 100 250 500 Unlimited … “Uncapped API access” (Enterprise).
Ahrefs provides a hosted MCP server that allows users with a Lite plan or higher to connect their Ahrefs account to supported AI tools.
